message: plan-build asks for a PLAN.md `## Conventions` section but also says the implementer reads only CLAUDE.md, the task and cited SPEC sections, so shared cross-task protocols (bench-before/after, gated-task rule, repro rule) had to be moved into CLAUDE.md as an extra section and cross-referenced from each task. The skill could say explicitly where shared per-task protocols belong.

foundry_mutate returned "Connection closed" on the second call (fast_loop.rs dsym>=30 mutation) with no result; working tree was clean afterwards, but the verdict was lost and had to be retried. The first mutate call's result (136 KB of make test output) also overflowed the tool-result limit and had to be parsed from a saved file.

foundry_mutate restored the mutated file but left a side effect: a killed mutant made proptest append a failing seed to the tracked crates/oracle/tests/chunking.proptest-regressions, dirtying the tree. The reviewer had to git checkout it by hand; mutate should restore (or snapshot) every tracked file its commands touch.
